name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: The Uplift: The American Dream
changes.summary: We celebrate the United States ahead of its 250th anniversary with stories about American heroes and pastimes. The founder of e.l.f. Cosmetics shares how he made a massive life change to become a Catholic priest.

changes.title: New round of strikes targeting Iran underway, U.S. officials say
changes.summary: A 10th straight night of U.S. strikes on Iran is underway as President Trump vows Tehran will pay for the deaths of three American soldiers over the weekend. CBS News senior national security correspondent Charlie D'Agata reports. Then, global affairs analyst Jonathan Wachtel joins to discuss the state of the war.

changes.title: U.S. gas prices back up to average of $4 a gallon, AAA says
changes.summary: As fighting with Iran ramps up, a gallon of regular gas is once again $4 on average, up 13 cents in one week, according to AAA. Severin Borenstein, professor at UC Berkeley's Haas School of Business, joins with analysis.

changes.title: Powerball ticket sales begin Tuesday in the United Kingdom
changes.summary: Powerball ticket sales in the United Kingdom will begin Tuesday, giving players across the Atlantic a chance at winning the same massive jackpot that U.S. players already play for. (Image credit: Jenny Kane).

changes.title: Inside the Deadly U.S. Airstrike on a Shadow Fleet Tanker
changes.summary: Evidence suggests the ship on which three Indian sailors died was not moving when it was struck in the Gulf of Oman, but it had been engaged in risky offshore transfers of oil.

changes.title: Video appears to show United employee threatening to call ICE on customer
changes.summary: A United Airlines employee appears to have been caught on video threatening to call U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement on a passenger last week at San Francisco International Airport.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Pulling Back on Energy Efficiency
changes.summary: The Trump administration is undoing fuel-saving efforts even as war in Iran, data centers and heat waves are pushing up gasoline and electricity costs.

changes.title: Houthis in Yemen Edge Closer to Entering U.S.-Iran War
changes.summary: The Iran-backed Houthi militia in Yemen has declared a Red Sea blockade on Saudi Arabia, potentially opening up a new front in the war rippling across the Middle East.

changes.title: Video appears to show United employee threaten to call ICE on customer

changes.title: Trump to Impose 50% Tariff on Many Canadian Goods
changes.summary: The administration will use an untested legal provision to put significant duties on Canadian exports, reigniting a clash with one of America’s biggest trading partners.
